subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the four guard assertions are repaired, should the privileged CodeQL, app-token, registry, release, and Codex-agent updates remain grouped with the routine setup-action bumps?
rationale: These action families execute with scanning, credential, publishing, or agent privileges, so their combined review and rollback scope requires owner intent beyond the mechanical assertion repair.

options.title: Keep the grouped update
options.body: Repair the guards and approve all verified immutable pins together after exact-head checks and secops review.

options.title: Split privileged families
options.body: Move security-sensitive action families into narrower PRs for separate review and rollback.

recommendation.title: Keep the grouped update
